name: stage-fright
description: Stage Fright — modular haunted-theater game bootstrap

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @stage-fright/core && npm run dev --workspace @stage-fright/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @stage-fright/core && npm run build --workspace @stage-fright/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @stage-fright/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @stage-fright/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @stage-fright/core && npm run test --workspace @stage-fright/core
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run version:check
